visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an animation of a mobile chat interface on a light blue background. A pink-haired character's avatar is on the left, next to a speech bubble containing scribbled lines and a sad face icon. A yellow-hooded character's avatar is visible on the right side of the screen. (2) The scene cuts to a character wearing a yellow hood and a brown shirt lying on a white bed with a brown wooden headboard. He is holding a dark grey smartphone with both hands, looking at the screen with a focused and slightly worried expression in a room with warm, flat lighting. (3) Close-up frames alternate between the phone screen showing two blue checkmarks and the character's wide, sweating eyes. The visual then shows a pink-haired girl in a white shirt looking down at her phone with an angry, furrowed expression and clenched teeth in a simple indoor setting. (4) A hand is shown writing the words "Goodbye love" with a black pen on a piece of lined white paper. Then, the pink-haired girl is seen standing under a transparent umbrella in the rain with suitcases, waiting for and then entering a blue taxi. (5) A white airplane is shown flying diagonally across a pale blue sky filled with soft white clouds, leaving a glowing yellow contrail in its wake. The animation style is clean and 2D, focusing on the movement of the plane across the vast sky. (6) White text reading "1 YEAR LATER" appears on a black screen. The pink-haired girl, now wearing glasses, is sitting at a table in a park during autumn, surrounded by falling red leaves. A man in a suit walks up and hands her a pink book. (7) Text reading "30 YEARS LATER" transitions the scene to the same park where the girl is now an elderly woman with grey hair. She sits on a bench next to an elderly man in a wheelchair, looking out at a city skyline during a sunset. (8) The camera returns to the yellow character on the bed, who is sweating profusely. He types into a text box on the "invideo AI" website on his phone and presses a blue button labeled "Generate" with his thumb. (9) A series of high-quality anime-style clips show an orange cat and a pink cat in various apology-themed scenarios. The video ends with a shot of the pink-haired girl in a shower, dropping her vibrating phone into a toilet as she reacts with surprise.

The sound of consistent rain creates a steady background texture, accompanied by the low rumble of a passing car engine. (3) The cinematic orchestral music continues, layered with the deep, powerful roar of an airplane engine that moves across the soundstage. The music then transitions into a more hopeful and calm orchestral piece as the environmental sounds fade into a quiet park atmosphere. (4) A digital "whoosh" sound effect transitions the audio into a segment dominated by the rapid, percussive clacking of a mechanical keyboard. The dramatic music is replaced by an upbeat, playful synth-pop background track with a steady drum beat and high energy. Exaggerated sound effects are audible, including loud munching and crunching, cartoon-style sobbing, and a final, resonant splash of water with bubbling sounds as the video reaches its conclusion.
